title: Free Image Generation API
subtitle: Deploy your own free AI image generation API - 100,000 calls/day using Cloudflare Workers AI
cons: Need to deploy your own Worker

pricing.freeTier: 100,000 API calls per day (Cloudflare Workers AI free tier)

deployment_steps.title: Create a New Worker
deployment_steps.desc: Go to Workers dashboard > Create application > Create Worker > Deploy

deployment_steps.title: Replace Worker Code
deployment_steps.desc: Replace the default code with worker.js from this repo, then Save and Deploy

deployment_steps.title: Set API Key
deployment_steps.desc: Settings > Variables > Add variable: API_KEY = your-secret-key

deployment_steps.title: Enable Workers AI
deployment_steps.desc: Go to Workers & Pages > AI > Enable Workers AI (free tier is enough)

deployment_steps.title: Add AI Binding
deployment_steps.desc: Settings > Variables > Service bindings > Add: Variable name=AI, Service=Workers AI

usage_examples.curl:
curl -X POST https://your-worker.workers.dev \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer your-api-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "A cute robot cooking breakfast"}' \
  --output image.jpg
